hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable WETH fee on every swap in NASDANK-launched Uniswap v4 pools, using beforeSwap and afterSwap return-delta mechanics to deduct fees from the WETH leg regardless of swap direction or exactness. Accrued WETH is split between an immutable project treasury and a protocol treasury, claimable permissionlessly via claim().
